$comment: Upskillers: participants in a Build Cycle. The button is given on joining a cycle; a confirmed contribution at Demo Day adds a brass rim (Builder). Facts from content/site/ladder.json, content/faq/time.json and design/research/recognition-system.md. Placeholders: the next cycle's dates, and who confirms a Builder.
description: Learn by building a real project with a small team, free, in person, near you.

title: Learn by building.
hero.alt: The Upskiller button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and UPSKILLER

intro.lede: The Upskilling Labs is a free community where people learn by building real projects together. As an Upskiller, you join a Pod for a Build Cycle and work on a real problem in your community, beside people who've been where you are.
intro.terms: About three months: six in-person events and a short check-in each week.
intro.status: [PLACEHOLDER] Next Build Cycle: dates to be set

items.title: Join a Pod.
items.body: A small group, a Poderator to keep it moving, and a real problem from your community.

items.title: Build it.
items.body: Around week eight you form a Project Team: three to five people who build one thing.

items.title: Show it at Demo Day.
items.body: Show your work in public, to the people whose problem it was.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Workshops and Build Cycles cost nothing.

items.title: In person, near you.
items.body: Six events at a local Lab, and the rest on your own time with your team.

items.title: Beginners welcome.
items.body: Beginners and experts work side by side.

items.title: Five minutes a week.
items.body: A short check-in keeps everyone moving.

path.title: Start with a workshop. Finish with something real.

steps.title: Come to a workshop.
steps.body: Free and hands-on. Most people start here.

steps.title: Join a Build Cycle.
steps.body: You get your Upskiller button on day one.

steps.title: Build with your team.
steps.body: Your Pod meets, your Project Team forms, and a Mentor is there when you're stuck.

steps.title: Demo Day.
steps.body: Show what you built. A confirmed contribution adds a brass rim to your button: you're a Builder.

button.title: Proof you're building.
button.body: Given to you when you join a Build Cycle. Wear it to your Pod, and to Demo Day.
button.rim: Contribute something that holds up, and a brass rim goes around it: Builder.

items.a: No. Workshops and Build Cycles are free.

items.q: How much time does a Build Cycle take?
items.a: About three months: six in-person events, a five-minute check-in each week, and the rest on your own time with your team.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. Beginners and experts work side by side, and you learn by doing.
At a free workshop. Join The Labs at theupskillinglabs.org to hear about the next one.

join.title: Come build with us.
join.lede: Start with a free workshop. The next Build Cycle takes it from there.
